comments.aburoyal: Ended 2024 quietly but starts out for a new yard off a reduced mark; not ruled out

comments.ifollowrivers: Promising in AW handicaps in 2025; also ran well on turf latest; stamina a possible query
comments.kingofspeed: Conditions to suit and he's been running well for a while now; inexperienced amateur rides
comments.northbound: Wide-margin C&D win in April for former yard; returning to AW should be beneficial

comments.roguesoldier: Poor form in three runs for new stable this year; plenty to prove for now
comments.royalobservatory: Virtually refused to race here latest; C&D win for this rider in April; capable but risky
comments.senseofworth: Course win (12f) in February; needs strong pace at this trip but has the ability to figure

comments.venturadream: 1m AW win in February; in and out since but things look in place for a big run this time

comments.queuedos: Career best when 2nd at Windsor last week; C&D winner; change of headgear; considered
comments.reddeef: Kempton 2nd last October gives him claims but he hasn't kicked on since; stable quiet
comments.rocknrollrocket: 5f win here last month and ran okay at Chester ten days ago; others better treated
comments.roguedancer: Two 6f wins on Tapeta; midfield on turf latest; could resume progress returned to AW
comments.sandsofdubai: Bred to leave 2yo form behind her in time but a 361-day absence is offputting
comments.shiplake: Over raced when winning at Newcastle in November (6f); open to considerable improvement
comments.skelligisle: Disappointing dropped to 5f at Lingfield (turf) latest; needs revival back over 6f & on AW
comments.styleking: Big chance on C&D second in April; well held on turf since; needs return to AW to revive

comments.advertorial: Well suited by step up to 1m4f when winning over C&D latest; modest form but can improve
comments.belabambina: Minor handicap form at up to 1m1f; not impossible on pedigree that she'll stay 1m4f
comments.bevy: Mild improvement when 5th in a classified over 1m1f here this month; could step up
comments.cudabeenarowlex: Won over 1m2f at Redcar in March but mixed in handicaps and trip query at 1m4f
comments.goldencrossing: Modest form as 2yo but bred to do better and trip should suit; has been gelded
comments.jedhiknight: Improved form when staying-on 3rd on handicap debut over 1m6f; shorter trip raises query
comments.maxthetiger: 1m6f was beyond him latest but previous 1m4f run on turf would put him in the picture
comments.orchestralwave: Signs of ability in qualifying runs; poor form over 1m since; dam won at 1m4f; new yard
comments.perfectruby: Not gone on from being awarded a 1m AW race in March; some hope for 1m4f in pedigree
comments.respirosolitario: Bred to stay 1m4f and he kept on strongly in 3rd over 1m2f at Leicester recently
comments.sydneywhistler: Creditable show on handicap debut (C&D) but hasn't done as well since; best left for now

races.raceComment: advertorial is marginally preferred with a score of 41.7%, holding clear edges in better ratings and better suited by conditions and stronger recent form over cudabeenarowlex. Won 1 of last 6 starts. verdict.comment: Top of the list is OLDBURY LAD, who was squeezed out just as he was building up a head of steam at Salisbury a fortnight ago.

comments.alltoobeautiful: No match for winner but still ran well when second on last month's handicap debut
comments.bamalama: Won three times (once over C&D) last season but yet to get going after four runs this year
comments.coiled: In poor form for new stable this year and now 0-13
comments.diamondcottage: C&D winner last month; well beaten on soft ground since; still on workable mark
comments.endowed: Ended long losing run with C&D win a week ago; competitive again under 4lb penalty
comments.ladydorchester: Badly out of form for new trainer this year (four runs)
comments.mehmo: Consistent 7yo who looked a shade unlucky when staying-on third at Brighton last month
comments.miakoda: 7f AW winner in March; player if combination of drop back in trip and new visor helps
comments.oldburylad: Hampered inside final furlong before keeping on for second at Salisbury this month
comments.runtomyside: Safely held in first three handicaps; tried cheekpieces last time; blinkers on here

races.raceComment: endowed is marginally preferred with a score of 54.2%, holding clear edges in better ratings over diamondcottage. Won 1 of last 6 starts, though unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile and regressive form need consideration.

verdict.comment: Recent winner Level Up is still well treated but ALL WAYS GLAMOROUS can confirm the promise of his Windsor success in May.

comments.allwaysglamorous: Won two of last four at 5f, cosily at Windsor in May; weak finisher latest; down in grade
comments.conniesrose: Front-runs; six wins here and three times beaten under 1l this year; likely player
comments.honouryourdreams: Two wins in May, at 5f and 6f; back to form when 3rd last week; held in sole C&D run
comments.levelup: Overcame difficulties to win over C&D this month; still well treated despite 4lb rise
comments.sosmart: Likes to lead; good 2nd at Sandown ten days ago but other front-runners in this field
comments.somenightmare: Multiple course wins; arrived late for narrow C&D win in May; never threatened since

races.raceComment: conniesrose is marginally preferred with a score of 60.1%, holding clear edges in better suited by conditions and superior course form over sosmart. Placed in 3 of last 6 starts. Ground (Good To Firm) looks ideal with 6 wins from 32 starts in similar conditions. Strong pace likely with multiple front-runners. Key attributes include strong course form, though unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile and regressive form need consideration.

comments.kamekist: Won handicap debut (6f, AW); solid 3rd over 7f since; thereabouts back at 6f

comments.overspiced: Two 5f wins in May; ran into well-treated one when 2nd latest; up 3lb; first 6f run

comments.saffredi: Two 6f wins on AW in October/April; found little back on turf; cheekpieces fitted
comments.tenclub: Well held over 7f on soft last time; C&D winner the time before and only 3lb higher here
comments.thurso: Improved handicap form since gelded; beat progressive one at Haydock (6f) latest; up 8lb

verdict.comment: This looks good for DARKENED EDGE, who bumped into one at Bath last time and there is nothing that is unexposed in today's field.

comments.cocohill: A repeat of her latest Bath fourth would see her involved in the finish
comments.darkenededge: Two good runs this year, including over C&D; looks a leading contender
comments.dreambyday: Looks on the downgrade and latest drop in the weights not enough to tempt
comments.fishermanscottage: Running well this year but he will need to raise his game a notch to come out on top
comments.moeslegacy: Dangerous mark and penultimate C&D run offered hope; disappointed back here last time
comments.werereunited: Nearly three years since last win but good 6f runs here the last twice; contender

races.raceComment: werereunited is marginally preferred with a score of 47.1%, holding clear edges in superior course form and more progressive over darkenededge. Placed in 1 of last 6 starts. Could develop into tactical affair with no obvious pace-setter, potentially favoring the selection's run style, though step up in class and unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile need consideration.

verdict.comment: Dylan O'Connor's valuable 7lb claim could make all the difference for the in-form EXPOUND, a C&D winner for the rider three starts ago

comments.billsilvers: Ran well off his reduced mark at Leopardstown last time, up 5lb but may remain competitive
comments.brewelhill: C&D winner on soft last July, plenty of improvement needed from recent seasonal debut
comments.casanova: Has struggled in seven starts since beating Expound at Listowel last autumn, up against it
comments.donnanook: 7f Dundalk winner, sights lowered now after a run in a conditions race at Gowran
comments.expound: C&D winner and handicap hurdle scorer in May, holding his form well, holds leading chance
comments.eyetrap: Stayed further than this when winning twice in Britain, useful recruit for the Burns team
comments.inamina: Maiden who has run over a range of trips; decent run over 7f at Leopardstown last Thursday
comments.loingseoir: Six-time winner over trips ranging from 7f-1m4f, best effort this term over 1m at Limerick
comments.ozarkdaze: Last two runs have been over further, previous C&D third good enough to put him in the mix
comments.sisenior: On a long losing sequence and not the most consistent sort, runner-up twice this season
comments.spy: Competitive over hurdles last summer, both Flat wins were gained in Britain in 2022
comments.titanium: A long way below his best in three outings this term, needs to show signs of revival
comments.tribalmoon: Solid AW performer, prominent showing at Leopardstown last time boosts his chance

races.raceComment: expound is marginally preferred with a score of 47.6%, holding clear edges in better suited by conditions and superior course form over sisenior. Won 2 of last 6 starts. Ground (Good) looks ideal with 5 wins from 18 starts in similar conditions, though step up in class and unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile need consideration.

comments.alloalkhawaneej: Ordinary form overall and distant twelfth at Listowel; maiden hurdle winner in April
comments.desertfriend: Last year's winner from 4lb lower mark; two good runs here and at Navan recently
comments.dontgowithjoe: Ran well in defeat in AW maiden starts; makes handicap debut fit from hurdling foray
comments.eveningsempire: Won over this trip from 1lb lower last summer; last of 11 on stable debut 12 days ago
comments.fianna: Fair maiden form; staying on in both handicap starts including at 2m recently at Listowel
comments.khormorsyd: Midfield finishes in maiden starts; keeping on when upped in trip recently; can improve
comments.magneticnorth: 11 time winner on Flat; some good runs for Rebecca Menzies; Limerick stable debut was okay
comments.msmessi: Big prices in maidens but not disgraced; last of 17 on handicap/stable debut last time
comments.outonfriday: Notched eighth career win last month; middling run last time at Gowran; inconsistent sort
comments.positiveenergy: Winner of handicap in October off 5lb lower; subsequent maiden hurdle winner; up in trip
comments.powerfulhookhead: Gelded since last of ten on handicap debut in October; maiden runs not bad; bit to find
comments.preparations: Bellewstown winner last year from 4lb lower mark; kept on into second last time; chance
comments.princessrabab: Second reserve; up 3lb for AW win in March; makes stable debut
comments.rauzan: Third reserve; 0-10 on Flat; four time hurdle winner last year; best watched on return
comments.spanishjohn: Big hike for winning a handicap last month; mediocre form in hurdling/Flat starts prior
comments.tassarolo: First reserve; middling runs at Dundalk last winter; winner of maiden hurdle on last start
comments.themediator: Bumper and hurdle winner; good runs in defeat in maidens; well behind on return last month

comments.shirazi: Plenty of progress when runner-up over C&D and just about sets the standard on that form

verdict.comment: A chance is taken on HATTIE SPARKS reversing Southwell form with Victoria tried over two furlong less, with cheekpieces reapplied.

races.raceComment: victoria is marginally preferred with a score of 36.6%, holding clear edges in better ratings over aloof. Won 1 of last 6 starts. Going is a significant concern - yet to win on Standard ground from 2 attempts. Could develop into tactical affair with no obvious pace-setter, though step up in class and unfavorable draw need consideration.
